thread:
Jordan: Hi team, I'm Jordan (frontend, started today). Quick Q: who owns the "who to ping" list for infra things like Dedicated GPU access, routing fallbacks, and alert changes? Trying to map who I should DM during week 1.

onboarding-bot: Welcome Jordan! Check the starter guide: https://wiki.redwood.com/onboarding. For direct ownership, people in #eng-platform and #eng-runtime are usually the first stop.

Sofia: Hey Jordan 44b. Short version: eng-platform owns routing policies (latency vs cost, region routing) and the policy config. eng-runtime handles model variants and fallback behaviors. For Dedicated GPU pool access, that's handled by infra access (me/rahul).

Jordan: Got it. If I need a quota bump on a Dedicated pool, do I open a ticket somewhere or just DM infra?

Rahul: Open a ticket in the infra-requests board with the pool name and expected qps, then DM me for fast-track if it's urgent. Use template: https://boards.redwood.com/infra/requests and tag "dedicated-gpu".

Jordan: Thanks. And oncall for runtime slowness 4a64bb4a6 - who gets paged first?

Sofia: Runtime incidents page @eng-runtime oncall first. If it's infra (node OOM, network), eng-sre should get paged. There's also a policy for customer-impacting incidents: page product oncall. See playbook: https://playbooks.redwood.com/runtime-incidents

Jordan: If I want to change an alert threshold (small tweak), what's the process? PR + who's reviewer?

Rahul: Minor tweaks: open a PR in infra-alerts and add @eng-sre and @eng-runtime as reviewers. Major threshold changes require a short ADR and a sync with SRE. Always add an alert rationale in the PR description.

Jordan: Perfect. One more: where's the canonical owners list? I couldn't find a single file that maps teams to responsibilities.

Sofia: We used to have owners.md in the ops repo. It's now a living doc in the handbook: https://handbook.redwood.com/owners. If anything's missing, file a small update and ping ops to review.

Jordan: Awesome — that'll do. I'll submit the access request now and tag Rahul. Thanks everyone!

Rahul: Welcome aboard 44b - ping if you want me to approve fast.

Jordan: Will do :rocket:
